title: Equivalences of cospan diagrams induce equivalences of limiting apices
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, coherent cones, cores and equivalence edges of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the limiting-cone mapping-space criterion of [lem-coef-infinity-terminal-pullback-criterion]. Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal C\prime$ be quasicategories. Consider two cospans $A\to C\leftarrow B$ and $A\prime\to C\prime\leftarrow B\prime$ in $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$, together with an objectwise equivalence between the cospans and a compatible map between coherent cones with apices $L$ and $L\prime$. If both cones are limiting, then the apex map $L\to L\prime$ is an equivalence in $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$. Equivalently, for every small quasicategory $Q$, postcomposition induces an equivalence of spaces $\operatorname{Fun}(Q,L)^\simeq\to\operatorname{Fun}(Q,L\prime)^\simeq$.
